mapper.select: SELECT f.create_time AS follow_time, u.id AS uid, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar AS avatar, (f2.id IS NOT NULL) AS followed FROM life_social.life_follow f # 与关注列表进行 内连接 取出所有关注数据 INNER JOIN life_social.life_user u ON u.id = f.follow_user_id AND u.deleted = 0 # 与自身进行左连接 取出与我有关的关注数据 LEFT JOIN life_social.life_follow f2 ON f2.follow_user_id = f.follow_user_id # 关联查询条件 AND f2.user_id = #{me} # 我是否关注了TA AND f2.deleted = 0 WHERE f.user_id = #{owner} AND f.deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC

SELECT f.create_time AS follow_time, u.id AS uid, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname, u.avatar AS avatar, (f2.id IS NOT NULL) AS followed FROM life_social.life_follow f INNER JOIN life_social.life_user u ON u.id = f.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN life_social.life_follow f2 ON f2.user_id = #{me} AND f2.follow_user_id = f.user_id AND f2.deleted = 0 WHERE f.follow_user_id = #{owner} AND f.deleted = 0 ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC
